Welcome
A fabWelcome!
On behalf of ‘Team Oxley’, the children, Trustees, staff members and myself, I am very proud to introduce you to our wonderful academy. Our website is designed to give you a ‘window into life at Oxley’. However, the best way to really get that feeling about Oxley is to come and visit! Please do get in touch and I will look forward to meeting you.

Welcome
Welcome from ourExecutive Principal
The village is purely designed around the child, with places to discover, places to imagine, and places to explore, all within a little world designed on a big person's world for little people!
Welcome from our Nursery Senior Lead
In our Nursery, every day is filled with curiosity, imagination, and joyful discovery. Our dedicated teachers create a nurturing and inspiring environment where every child feels safe, valued, and excited to explore. At the heart of our setting is our belief in creating a little world for little people — a place where early steps lead to big possibilities. Nursery is the beginning of our Dream journey, where children start imagining, wondering, and discovering who they are and what they love. For families who continue with us into the main school, this journey grows stronger. Children move seamlessly from Dream into Believe and then Achieve, staying connected to the same ethos, values, and nurturing approach. Together, they continue building confidence, friendships and a love of learning that carries them forward year after year. Whether children are painting, exploring nature, storytelling, building, or simply enjoying magical moments with friends, each experience helps them grow, question, and dream even bigger. Our Nursery Village is more than a place to learn — it’s a community filled with warmth, kindness, and possibilities. We can’t wait to walk this special journey with you. Welcome to our village, where little steps begin a lifelong adventure — to Dream, Believe and Achieve.

pageCache.pageTitle: Key Information and Frequently Asked Questions - Oxley Park Academy & Nursery
pageCache.text:
Key InfoKey Information and Frequently Asked Questions
Text
Location
Our Nursery Village is situated on our Shenley Wood campus. You access it from the gate at the front of the school. It is clearly marked and is separate to the main school gate.
Who do I contact to arrange a visit, apply for a place or just ask a question?
You can contact our Academy Admin Centre, where any of our lovely admin staff will do their very best to help. In person, please use the main academy entrance where you will find our welcome desk.
The Nursery VillageOxley Park AcademyShenley Wood campusMerlewood DriveShenley WoodMilton KeyesMK5 6GG
Email - nursery@oxleyparkacademy.com
Phone - 01908 506899
Session Times
We are extremely flexible on days and sessions we provide. You can choose your days and sessions, and if we have space we will of course allocate the place to your child.
Morning Session - 8.30am - 11.30am
Afternoon Session - 12.15pm - 3.15pm
All Day Session - 8.30am - 3.15pm (please note this includes an optional charge of £5.00 for the additional 45 minutes extension that is not funded as part of the free entitlement)
Can I make changes to my hours?
We will always endeavour to cater for any requests to change of hours or days. These will need to be submitted to our Shenley Wood Admin Centre at least two weeks before the end of any term. If we have space and we are able to cater for the requested changes, these will be implemented from the start of the following term.
What if I need to leave the Nursery?
In order to leave the Nursery, you will need to ensure you give us 4 weeks' notice.
Can our child attend before and after-school club?
Yes they can! Premier Education is our provider for our Ziggy Before and After School care. This provision is based at our Shenley Wood campus and children can attend during the following hours:
Before school: 7.30am to 8.30am
After school: 3.00pm to 6.00pm
Breakfast and evening snack is provided during these sessions. A wide range of activities are provided and our provider is Ofsted registered. For bookings and further information please contact our Academy Admin Centre. A booking app will be open nearer to September.
Fees, bills and payments
Additional Sessions - £6 an hour
Optional extension to free entitlement for all day session - £5.00 a session
Hot/Cold Lunch - £2.70
Late Payment Fee - £10
Additional sessions are billed at the start of each term. These are payable within 14 days of the dated invoice. Please note a late payment charge of £10 will be applied for any late payments after this date.
Claiming Free sessions through the 30-Hour Codes
30 Hour Codes are valid for three months and have to be renewed continually. This is your responsibility as a parent or carer. Please understand the academy will not be able to claim funding if these are not renewed. If this is the case, this will result in sessions being billed to you.
Can I pay for the Nursery using childcare vouchers? Who do I contact if I have any finance queries?
Yes, you can. If you require any further information or require any help checking 30-hour eligibility please contact our Academy Admin Centre, nursery@oxleyparkacademy.com for further information.
Attendance
Being a member of our wonderful village is being part of our school family. We all follow the same values and expectations. Although children are under statutory school age, we do expect them to fully attend their allocated sessions. If your child's attendance falls below 63%, as calculated over the course of a term, this will reduce the level of funding received by the academy from Milton Keynes Council. Therefore, allocated sessions not attended will be payable by parents/carers. The academy will write to parents/carers if it is noted that absence is slipping towards this figure.
What do I do if my child is genuinely sick and can't attend nursery?
Please call the Academy absence line on 01908 506899 by 8.15am. When leaving a message, please make sure you say your child's name really clearly. Make sure we know the reason for their absence. Thank you in advance. If your child has an upset tummy or sickness, they should return no sooner than 48 hours after showing the last symptoms.
Further Frequently Asked Questions
How are medicines administered?
Medicines can only be administered if a medicine form has been completed. However, if your child suffers from an ongoing medical condition that requires medicines e.g. Asthma, and is using an inhaler, it is of course expected that you bring this into Nursery and a member of our Academy Admin Team will liaise with you regarding a health care plan.
What things should I tell the Nursery Village staff?
Please let us know if your child has any allergies or medical conditions. We should be aware of anything your child really doesn’t like. If your child is going to be absent from Nursery or going on holiday, or your child has been affected by a change in family circumstances, please let us know. It will help us to be sensitive to your child’s moods and feelings. We would really prefer that toys are left at home, however, if your child absolutely will not come to Nursery without a favourite toy, we will put it safely in the cupboard so that it does not get broken or lost.

pageCache.pageTitle: Campuses & Facilities - Oxley Park Academy & Nursery
pageCache.text:
About UsCampuses & Facilities
Text
Oxley Park Campus
Our original campus, built in 2005, sits at the heart of the Oxley Park estate on Redgrave Drive. This site caters for children from Reception to Year 6, with two classes in each year group. It is a lively, well‑established environment where creativity and curiosity thrive.
Shenley Wood Campus
Located in the neighbouring grid square on Merlewood Drive, our Shenley Wood campus provides a one‑form‑entry pathway from Reception to Year 6. This campus is also home to The Nursery Village, which offers high‑quality early years provision for children aged 3 and above.
From September 2026, Shenley Wood will additionally host our brand‑new SEND unit, The Hive, offering 16 places for primary‑aged children who require specialist support.
Across both campuses, we welcome around 700 children and proudly serve families from Oxley Park, Kingsmead, Shenley Wood and across Milton Keynes City from our growing out of catchment community.
Our Facilities
We are incredibly fortunate to enjoy an outstanding range of facilities across our two sites, including:
Onsite after school club provision for all.
Two spacious school halls
Two fully equipped libraries with a wide range of books
A state‑of‑the‑art 3D immersive room
Extensive outdoor grounds featuring a natural field
A MUGA 3G football pitch
A red MUGA pitch complete with full running track and courts
Inspiring forest school environments
Two extensive playgrounds with a whole range of play zones.
High‑quality, creatively designed classrooms throughout
Two STEM centres with a range of iPads, laptops and Chrome books
On-site kitchens for both sites, cooking hot fresh food daily
State of the art Nursery space and outdoor village
Two new Early Years outdoor areas
Two sensory calm rooms
A new purpose built SEND unit (opening September 2026)
These facilities allow us to offer rich, varied and engaging learning experiences that place children at the centre of all we do.
Subpages

Key InfoAdmissions
Text
Applications for places at Oxley Park Academy are made directly through Milton Keynes Council. Once a place is confirmed, we will allocate your child to the appropriate campus.
Families are always kept together on the same site.
For Reception starters in September, children living in Kingsmead and areas up to the Oxley Park campus are typically allocated to Oxley Park.
Families living east of the Oxley Park campus, those in Shenley Wood, and those outside our catchment are generally allocated to the Shenley Wood campus.
However, we always strive to support individual family requests wherever possible. For in‑year admissions, campus placement depends on where space is available.
If this sounds like the school for you, take a closer look through our website and come join the Oxley family.
